query: I finally tried that new matcha boba shop downtown yesterday, the taro pearls were so chewy and they even had a little lychee jelly topping that I’ve never seen anywhere else before. I ended up staying there for almost two hours reading the new graphic novel I picked up at the bookstore next door, the art style is so vibrant and the story has such a fun cozy mystery vibe. Oh, and on my walk home I saw a golden retriever puppy wearing a tiny little rain boot on one paw because it’d stepped in a mud puddle, it was the cutest thing I’ve seen all week. But anyway, I’m abroad right now and my mobile data isn’t working at all, I checked and airplane mode is turned on, my network preference seems like it’s set wrong, there’s a bad VPN running on my device, data mode is toggled off, data saver mode is enabled, and I also have roaming turned off. Can you help me figure out how to fix this so I can get internet access?
